reference.name: Slice Economics
reference.text:
Problem: Slice Economics
Partners: Ana and Ben

PLAN
START
INPUT pizzeria name
INPUT pizza price
INPUT number of slices
SET cost per slice TO pizza price / number of slices
IF cost per slice <= 2.00 THEN
    PRINT pizzeria name and "is a good deal"
ELSE
    PRINT pizzeria name and "costs more than $2.00 a slice"
END IF
END

reference.name: Split the Check
reference.text:
Problem: Split the Check
Partners: Cy and Dee

PLAN
START
INPUT restaurant name
INPUT bill total
INPUT tip percentage
INPUT number of people
SET total with tip TO bill total + bill total * tip percentage / 100
SET cost per person TO total with tip / number of people
IF cost per person <= 15.00 THEN
    PRINT restaurant name and "everyone is within what they said they would spend"
ELSE
    PRINT restaurant name and "each person is over the $15.00 they agreed to"
END IF
END

reference.name: Grade Forecast
reference.text:
Problem: Grade Forecast
Partners: Eli and Fay

PLAN
START
INPUT student name
INPUT homework percentage
INPUT labs percentage
INPUT test percentage
SET weighted average TO homework * 0.30 + labs * 0.30 + test * 0.40
IF weighted average >= 70 THEN
    PRINT student name and "is on track to pass"
ELSE
    PRINT student name and "is below the passing mark"
END IF
END

reference.name: Fuel Stop
reference.text:
Problem: Fuel Stop
Partners: Gus and Hal

PLAN
START
INPUT car name
INPUT miles per gallon
INPUT gallons the tank holds
SET distance on a full tank TO miles per gallon * gallons
IF distance on a full tank >= 275 THEN
    PRINT car name and "can make the trip without a gas stop"
ELSE
    PRINT car name and "will need a gas stop"
END IF
END

reference.name: different words and keywords (Slice Economics, lowercase, ask/otherwise/say)
reference.text:
Problem: Slice Economics
Partners: Ivy and Jo

PLAN
start
ask for the name of the pizza place
ask for the price of the pizza
ask for how many slices it has
work out the cost per slice: the price divided by the slices
if the cost per slice is $2.00 or less
    say that the place is a good deal
otherwise
    say that it costs too much per slice
end

reference.name: different words and keywords (Fuel Stop, reversed question, branches swapped to match)
reference.text:
Problem: Fuel Stop
Partners: Kai and Lu

PLAN
BEGIN
GET car name
GET miles per gallon
GET tank size in gallons
SET miles on one tank = miles per gallon times tank size
IF miles on one tank < 275 THEN
    OUTPUT the car needs a gas stop
ELSE
    OUTPUT no gas stop is needed
END IF
STOP

reference.name: terse Split the Check, tip as a decimal
reference.text:
Problem: Split the Check
Partners: Mo and Ned

START
INPUT place
INPUT bill
INPUT tip percent
INPUT people
SET each TO bill * (1 + tip percent / 100) / people
IF each <= 15 THEN
    PRINT "Everyone is fine at " each
ELSE
    PRINT "Over $15.00 each"
END IF
END
